bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/file_provider.rs, springboard/ui/src/file_provider.rs, springboard/sdk/src/file_coordination.rs, springboard/sdk/src/fswatch.rs, springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs, springboard/src/shell/docpanel.rs (local document grants only)
summary: Apple's File Provider framework lets an app's extension expose remote or managed files to the system, with replicated or nonreplicated placeholder-based sync. BifrOSt still has no provider extension host, no placeholder or on-demand hydration and no provider search. It now has an in-process domain registry, provided-item and capability models, the official provider error codes, and queued enumerator signals, but nothing delivers those signals to a provider or the shell yet.

features.feature: Share local files without an extension
features.apple: UIFileSharingEnabled / LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace, document browser (landing page 'Share files locally')
features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs (Opener, Grants), springboard/src/shell/docpanel.rs (desktop document panel), springboard/sdk/src/document.rs
features.note: Per-app grants open and save files through a broker with a 'documents' permission. There is no in-place sharing setting, and the picker is confined to the account home (docs/file-portal-design.md).

features.feature: Replicated File Provider extension (sync local copies with remote storage)
features.bifrost: none in bifrost-os; cloud sync lives in ~/Projects/bifrost-cloud, outside this repo
features.note: No extension host, no upload or download queue, and no remote-to-local sync inside the desktop.

features.feature: Nonreplicated File Provider extension (managed local files with placeholders)
features.note: No placeholder or dataless file concept, and no on-demand hydration. Files app reads and writes ordinary files only (springboard/src/files/fs.rs).

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/file_provider.rs (DomainRegistry: add, remove, disconnect, reconnect, signal_enumerator, take_signals)
features.note: In-process registry of domains and coalesced enumerator signals with generations. Nothing reads the signals yet: there is no extension process to receive them and no reimport, waitForChanges or materialized-item enumerator.

features.feature: Provided items (item, identifier, capabilities, type and creator)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/file_provider.rs (ItemIdentifier, ItemCapabilities, TypeAndCreator, ProvidedItem), springboard/src/files/fs.rs (local item model)
features.note: Provider items carry an identifier, parent, validated filename, content type, type and creator codes and a capability set; rename and reparent check their capability. No content version, sync anchor or download state.
Quick search indexes local content only. Apps cannot register a provider search source.

Domains have an identifier, display name, storage path, replicated, hidden, user-enabled and disconnected state, with validation. No external volume eligibility (volume unsupported reasons), no known-folder replication and no testing modes.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/file_provider.rs (ErrorCode, ProviderError, RegistryError), springboard/sdk/src/file_coordination.rs (CoordinationError: Timeout, Io)
features.note: 19 official provider error codes, with item association and retry or restart classification. There is no user-info dictionary and no item-key metadata beyond the item identifier, and the error domain is this crate's own name.

features.feature: Coordinated access to items shared with other processes (adjacent, Foundation)
features.note: Advisory flock on the parent directory, with a 5 s timeout. Presenters get change callbacks. There is no relinquish or save negotiation, no will-move callback, and no versions.

features.feature: Change feed for item updates (adjacent, FSEvents)
features.apple: FSEventStream as used by providers to detect changes
features.note: Changes are reported for local folders only. Apps get the feed, but nothing connects it to a remote provider.
Apple's metrics pipeline is a developer-portal service for providers distributed through the Apple store.

gaps: No provider extension host: no replicated or nonreplicated extension, and no way for an app to register a provider process.
Enumerator signals are queued but never delivered: no provider or shell reads them, and there is no reimport, waitForChanges or materialized-item enumeration.
No placeholder (dataless) files and no on-demand hydration in Files or the document panel.
No provider search source; quick search covers local content only.
No external volume eligibility (volume unsupported reasons) and no known-folder replication for domains.
Documented plan to open the file system to a provider is absent: docs/file-portal-design.md covers only local grants and the picker, and it says nothing about a cloud provider.
Coordination is advisory and has no save negotiation, no relinquish, and no versions, so a provider cannot hold a file safely while it syncs.
